changelog:
- In-App Updates: Background check on startup with top-bar update notification & changelog dialog
- Pull-to-Refresh in Oasis: Smooth page reloading matching Material 3 theme colors
- Edge Swipe Navigation: Swipe right to go back, swipe left to go forward in Oasis history
- Performance Boost: Lazy WebView initialization for lightning-fast app startup
- Polished UI: Aligned Oasis bottom bar buttons and address bar
